# Ovillo

> A ball of thread for making sounds with your agent. You write a score in MUS (plain text); a persistent physical world called Ariadne (strings, a wooden top, the air in the box, a room) plays it; every render prints a receipt whose energy ledger balances. Source: https://github.com/sophia-labs/ovillo (MIT).

Rules for agents (from the repository's AGENTS.md): never invent physics or numbers. Every claim about how something sounds, or why, cites a spec section or a receipt field; if neither says it, say you don't know, or render and read the receipt. A successful render is not by itself a theorem about transport, a biological reconstruction, intelligible speech, or listener perception.

## Build and render

    git clone https://github.com/sophia-labs/ovillo.git
    cd ovillo/mus-rs && cargo build --release -p mus-cli
    ./target/release/mus render ../examples/tab/steel_string_tour.mus -o tour.wav --json
    ./target/release/mus render ../examples/tab/steel_string_tour.mus -o tour.wav --energy trace.json

Read the receipt: `badTokens` must be empty (note: `mus check` does not yet verify tab positions; `mus render` reports a pitch/position disagreement in `badTokens`). `ariadneWorlds[]` carries `planDigest`, the touches (plucks, hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides) and the ledger: `sourceWork`, `controlWork`, `internalLoss`, `radiation`, `cumulativeClosureResidual`, `maximumFrameResidual`.

## Specs

- [SPEC.md](https://github.com/sophia-labs/ovillo/blob/main/SPEC.md): MUS, the score language
- [SPEC-TAB.md](https://github.com/sophia-labs/ovillo/blob/main/SPEC-TAB.md): annotated tab, `@string:fret`, hands as dot-voices (`gt.p`, `gt.v`, `gt.r`), `ho` `po` `sl` `harm`
- [SPEC-ARIADNE-STEEL-STRING.md](https://github.com/sophia-labs/ovillo/blob/main/SPEC-ARIADNE-STEEL-STRING.md): the guitar-shaped world, its receipts, and "Limits of v0"
- [ARIADNE-PURE-PHYSICS-CONSTITUTION.md](https://github.com/sophia-labs/ovillo/blob/main/ARIADNE-PURE-PHYSICS-CONSTITUTION.md): what the world may and may not do
- [ovillo/README.md](https://github.com/sophia-labs/ovillo/blob/main/ovillo/README.md): the bench app, its score JSON, and its MCP server (`ovillo-mcp`)

## This site

- /: the live bench (the Ovillo rig compiled to WebAssembly in an AudioWorklet) and the listening room
- /sounds/manifest.json: every piece: title, engine, tags, note, audio, score, receipt, ledger numbers
- /sounds/<slug>.mus or .json: the score that made it; /sounds/<slug>.receipt.json: its render receipt
- /bench/: the bench alone
